subject.title: fix: persist queued iOS watch replies

question: Should this PR wait for real Apple Watch or diagnostic WatchConnectivity proof after conflict resolution, or may maintainers explicitly override that proof gap?
rationale: The changed path is user-visible Watch delivery plus durable message/session state, while the available evidence is source/CI/Testbox proof and the discussion says no physical Watch round-trip was available.

options.title: Require real Watch proof
options.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and require redacted Apple Watch or WatchConnectivity proof showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart before merge.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the missing physical Watch proof after reviewing the source, regression tests, and conflict resolution.

options.title: Fold into broader outbox stack
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer to carry the Watch reply portion through the broader offline outbox stack.

recommendation.title: Require real Watch proof
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun exact-head checks, and require redacted Apple Watch or WatchConnectivity proof showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete adopted the branch, posted the land-ready review, and has the clearest recent ownership of the affected iOS/watch paths.
